messages:
Samira Patel: Quick design review note from compliance session earlier today — a few export + copy/accessibility nits for the Audit & Logs page. Dropping raw notes here.

Samira Patel: Export dialog: default columns include full user_emails and IP addresses. Compliance raised that exports should default to excluding PII unless the admin explicitly opts in. Suggested default: show a checked section "Include PII (requires admin consent)" unchecked.

Ethan Brooks: +1. Implementation: backend can keep full data but API should support export mask param `mask_pii=true` by default. Frontend to show visible pill: "PII excluded" with an info icon.

Lina Park: Copy tweak for the export modal header — current: "Export logs". Proposed: "Export audit logs" and a subhead: "Exports may contain sensitive data. Review export options before downloading." keep short.

Victor Ramos: Also add a two-line summary of retention on the modal: e.g., "This export contains data retained for X days per your org settings." Link to policy.

Samira Patel: Bulk actions UX: when deleting audit entries (allowed for on-prem/private), our confirmation text says "Delete selected items?" which felt soft. Suggest stronger copy: "Permanently delete selected audit entries. This action cannot be undone." add a checkbox "I understand this is permanent" for destructive actions.

Lina Park: Accessibility note: the confirmation checkbox needs an explicit label and the focus must move to the checkbox when modal opens. Screen readers should announce number of items being deleted.

ux-bot: Accessibility checklist: focus trap in modal, ARIA role=alert for success/failure, descriptive label on checkbox e.g., "Confirm permanent deletion of 42 items".

Ethan Brooks: CSV headers: current exported headers use internal field names (e.g., user_id, req_ts). We should use human-friendly headers (User email, Time (UTC), Action). Also provide a machine-friendly option via toggle "Include internal headers".

Victor Ramos: Region selector in export: defaulting to "All regions" caused confusion during review. Suggest default to org home region and expose an explicit "All regions" option. Add small hint: "Choose region scope for compliance reasons".

Samira Patel: KMS visibility: ensure export does not include raw KMS identifiers. Either omit the KMS column from export or export masked aliases. Security prefers masked.

security-bot: Recommended: mask KMS alias to show last 3 characters and add column "KMS key (masked)". Include audit log ID for traceability instead of full key value.

Lina Park: Copy micro-nit: use consistent verb voice across UI: e.g., "Download export" vs "Export now". Pick one. I vote for "Download export" in the modal CTA.

Ethan Brooks: Localization: some languages put CTA first. Make sure CTA width can expand, and avoid mergable strings — CTA should be single string key.

Samira Patel: Data subject requests (DSR) flow: include a note in export modal: "For DSRs, use the DSR page to request full user data. Exports are limited to admin-scope only." Keeps users from misusing export.

Victor Ramos: Tiny UI: When toggle "Include PII" is off, greys out the columns in the preview table with clear tooltip "Hidden because PII excluded". Don't use very light gray — contrast requirement.

ux-bot: Contrast check: disabled preview rows must meet 3:1 contrast for AA large text or 4.5:1 for normal text.

Samira Patel: Accessibility copy for masked KMS cell: "KMS key alias, masked for export" as aria-label. Also add keyboard shortcut to reveal full value in a secure modal.

Lina Park: Edge case: orgs with cross-region keys need a small badge in the preview column: "cross-region". Also include a sortable column for region in the export preview.

Ethan Brooks: Dev note: API will add `export_scope` payload with fields: columns[], mask_pii, region_scope. We'll gate full export permission with a new `audit_export` permission.

Samira Patel: Action items: Lina to update modal mock and preview table states; Ethan to draft API contract and permission changes; Victor to update copy for modal header, CTA, and destructive confirm; ux-bot/security-bot to produce final aria strings and contrast numbers.

Victor Ramos: I'll write the wording for the deletion confirmation and the export subhead, pinging legal for DSR phrasing.

Samira Patel: timeline: aim for a small patch next sprint. If anyone sees other export/PII edge cases, drop them here. Thanks all. :wave:

Lina Park: one more UX nit — change microcopy from "Anonymize" to "Mask PII". Users misunderstood anonymize as irreversible. Mask is clearer.

Samira Patel: good point. Marking that as copy change in Victor's tasks.

security-bot: Final quick: ensure export logs include an audit entry for who ran the export, with mask status noted.
